question: Can the audited parameterized inherited carrier (git blob b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796, sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72) be landed byte-identically at the shipped path src/spider/kernel.py through the sanctioned product promotion path (.github/workflows/product-promote.yml), such that after promotion the shipped execution path contains a concrete parameterized mechanism that an inherited procedure visibly instantiates and executes on a real task, together with a companion known-negative refusal certificate -- i.e. readiness condition B1 is cleared and the pre-freeze executable mechanism required by readiness condition (1) exists -- rather than once more running the four-arm economics benchmark on a kernel that still emits literals at confidence 0.5 below the 0.8 execution threshold?
hypothesis: Installing the audited carrier bytes byte-identically at src/spider/kernel.py -- while keeping the shipped literal distill() path and its 0.5 confidence unchanged -- makes the shipped package able to (a) induce one parameterized mechanism per (family, resource_type) from repeated successful observations captured on the frozen credential-free localhost HTTP substrate (F1 documents/records, F2 widgets/gadgets; confidence 0.9; slots session_token/property/value/<derived id>; id-slot support grammar ^<type>\-0[0-9]{2}$), resolve every held-out novelty-0.0 in-support identifier (doc/rec/wid/gad -013,-026,-039,-052,-065) to EXECUTABLE with a correctly bound action whose URL contains the held-out identifier, execute it over real HTTP (200, body.success true) and verify() it true, with NO cold fallback; (b) refuse all three known-negative constructions (out-of-support identifier, missing required parameter, wrong intent) with bound_action null and a non-empty category-correct reason; (c) while the IDENTICAL induced mechanism and IDENTICAL input on the unmodified pre-install shipped bytes over-accept (resolve EXECUTABLE and produce a bound action for the out-of-support and path-traversal values the carrier refuses) and the pre-install bytes cannot induce at all (no distill_parameterized/_support_accepts/_infer_support/TrajectoryCounters; ImportError/AttributeError) -- so the installed carrier's support guard, and only the installed carrier, is the discriminating active ingredient; (d) reproduce the already-AUDIT-PASS frozen synthetic arm-differentiation certificate (6/6 positive round trips, 24/24 declared negatives refused, treatment contrast with degenerate-variant detection, accounting fidelity, identity binding, literal floor 0 held-out executables) under the durable-install condition; and (e) pass the sanctioned promotion validation suite (compileall, unittest including the new tests/test_ship_kernel.py regression test, scripts/validate_repo.py) such that the promotion delta extractable by product-promote.yml from 'git diff --binary --full-index <pre_execute_sha> <verdict-creation commit> -- src tests sdk pyproject.toml' is EXACTLY {src/spider/kernel.py (carrier bytes), tests/test_ship_kernel.py}.
falsifier: After a correct byte-identical installation (C0 passes), failure of any gating core C1-C5 falsifies the hypothesis: C1 real positive success < 10/10, C2 real refusal < 30/30 or any refusal with a wrong category or a non-null bound_action, C3 pre-install discrimination absent (pre-install bytes can induce, or the pre-install kernel refuses the out-of-support id that the carrier refuses -- i.e. no separating behavioral pair exists, or the pre-install kernel does not over-accept the out-of-support/path-traversal values the carrier refuses), C4 synthetic certificate not PASS (any of the six frozen checks false or a non-vacuity condition failing), or C5 promotion suite (compileall / unittest / validate_repo) failing. Failure of an integrity check C6-C10 is MEASUREMENT_INVALID, never a falsification: C6 promotion-delta integrity, C7 literal-floor preservation, C8 accounting fidelity, C9 real-HTTP validity, C10 no-benchmark scope. A missing frozen prerequisite or an impossible in-scope installation is BLOCKED, not a scientific result.

decision_rule.precedence: Total and ordered: (1) if a frozen prerequisite artifact is missing or the carrier cannot be installed at src/spider/kernel.py => BLOCKED; (2) else if C0 fails => MEASUREMENT_INVALID; (3) else if any gating core C1-C5 fails => FALSIFIES; (4) else if any integrity check C6-C10 fails => MEASUREMENT_INVALID; (5) else => SUPPORTS. The region {a core fails AND an integrity check fails} maps to FALSIFIES by step 3, so no evaluated state is undefined.

outcome_mapping.SUPPORTS: C0 passes and all of C1-C10 pass.
outcome_mapping.FALSIFIES: C0 passes AND at least one gating core C1-C5 fails (regardless of C6-C10).
outcome_mapping.MEASUREMENT_INVALID: C0 fails, OR (C0 and C1-C5 all pass AND at least one of C6-C10 fails).
outcome_mapping.BLOCKED: a frozen prerequisite is missing or the in-scope installation of src/spider/kernel.py is impossible.

product_consequence_positive: On SUPPORTS, readiness condition B1 is cleared: the audited parameterized-inheritance carrier is established on the shipped path with a known-positive executable round trip on a real task, a companion known-negative refusal certificate (30/30 real across three classes + 24/24 synthetic declared negatives), a behavioral treatment-vs-pre-install discrimination (the same mechanism+input is refused by the carrier and accepted by the pre-install bytes), identity binding, accounting fidelity and a passing promotion suite. The frozen src/tests promotion delta is exactly {src/spider/kernel.py (byte-identical carrier) + tests/test_ship_kernel.py}, which product-promote.yml extracts from 'git diff --binary --full-index <pre_execute_sha> <verdict_commit> -- src tests sdk pyproject.toml' and applies to main. The Product lane may then authorize promotion (DIRECTOR verdict promote_to_product=true after AUDIT PASS) and proceed to the four-arm economics thread now that a shipped treatment exists that can demonstrate an executable inherited parameterized mechanism plus known-negative refusal; C-PARAM-INHERIT remains EXPERIMENTAL until the DIRECTOR adjudicates the claim, and this packet is a readiness/promotion certificate, not a claim-generalization test.
product_consequence_negative: On FALSIFIES the shipped path does not carry the mandate's mechanism: the failing check (C1 support too narrow / C2 refusal leakage / C3 no separation / C4 certificate / C5 suite) names the next bounded repair, no promotion is authorized (promote_to_product=false), and C-PARAM-INHERIT stays EXPERIMENTAL with no advance. On MEASUREMENT_INVALID the instrument (identity, literal floor, accounting, promotion delta, real-HTTP validity or benchmark scope), not the mechanism, is at fault and the run must not be read as scientific evidence. On BLOCKED the smallest next action is to restore the missing frozen artifact or grant the required scope.
estimated_cost: Small and bounded: one EXECUTE run, stdlib only, no external network, no model calls, no credentials, no browser. No GPU, no LLM calls, no credentials.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: All four outcomes have non-empty trigger sets and the precedence is total with no undefined region (the region {core fails AND integrity fails} maps to FALSIFIES by step 3). Thresholds are arithmetically attainable with fixed positive denominators: the novelty-0.0 held-out set is exactly 10 tasks (5 per family; ids 013/026/039/052/065; DESIGN PROBE-A verified grammar acceptance of all five and disjointness from training ids 011/022/033/044/055); the refusal battery is exactly 30 (3 constructions x 10); the synthetic thresholds are the audited runner's own declared 6/6 and 24/24 (fixture.py imported at DESIGN: 6 FAMILIES, negative_cases() == 24); the literal floor 0.5 < 0.8 is a fixed constant; rc==0 gates are concrete.
